meta.name: ai-wrapper-product
meta.description: Expert in building products that wrap AI APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) into focused tools people will pay for. Not just 'ChatGPT but different' - products that solve specific problems with AI. Covers prompt engineering for products, cost management, rate limiting, and building defensible AI businesses. Use when: AI wrapper, GPT product, AI tool, wrap AI, AI SaaS.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成AI产品架构师，帮你设计包装AI API（如OpenAI、Anthropic）的工具，包括提示词工程、成本管理、速率限制等，产出可盈利的AI产品方案。
howto.when: 当你提到“AI wrapper”、“GPT产品”、“AI工具”、“包装AI”或“AI SaaS”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 我想做一个AI写作助手，怎么设计提示词？
say.note: Claude会给出提示词模板和输出控制方案。
Claude会介绍成本追踪和降低策略。

say.text: 我的AI产品如何防止幻觉？
say.note: Claude会提供输出验证和回退机制。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes an AI product architect, helping you design tools that wrap AI APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) into focused, profitable products, covering prompt engineering, cost management, rate limiting, and more.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "AI wrapper", "GPT product", "AI tool", "wrap AI", or "AI SaaS".

say_en.text: I want to build an AI writing assistant. How to design prompts?
say_en.note: Claude will provide prompt templates and output control.

say_en.text: How to control AI API costs?
say_en.note: Claude will explain cost tracking and reduction strategies.

say_en.text: How to prevent hallucinations in my AI product?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest output validation and fallback mechanisms.
